title: 第740章 三尖两刃枪第739章 是非黑白
lines: 翌日清晨，沐王亲自带他出了王府。
没有车马，没有随从，只有小黄门远远跟在后面，像一道不起眼的影子。
他们穿过府城最繁华的长街，拐进一条不起眼的小巷。
巷子尽头是一扇斑驳的木门，门上没有匾额，没有字号，只有门楣上刻着一个早已被风雨侵蚀得模糊不清的“匠”字。
木门后是另一番天地。
庭院不大，青砖铺地，墙角堆着几口巨大的水缸，缸中养着睡莲。
虽是初冬，莲叶已枯，却仍有几尾锦鲤在残叶下缓缓游动。
一位须发皆白的老者蹲在廊下，手里捏着一柄小锤，正在敲打一块巴掌大的铁片。
他的动作不急不躁，每一锤都落在同一个地方，火星四溅，铁片在他手中渐渐变薄，变亮，像一片正在舒展的叶子。
“老余头，别敲你那破铁片了，来活儿了。”
沐王的语气随意得不像是在跟一位宗师级别的匠人说话。
老余头抬起头，看了沐王一眼，又看了陆沉一眼，目光在他身上停留了片刻，然后放下小锤，站起身来。
他个头不高，背微微佝偻，穿着一身沾满铁锈和灰烬的粗布衣衫。
若不是沐王方才那一声“老余头”，陆沉几乎以为这只是个寻常的铁匠。
可他那双眼睛不一样。
浑浊中带着一种锐利，像是能在瞬间看透一块铁的好坏，也能看透一个人的深浅。
“属下见过王爷，王爷请。”
老余头转身带路，朝屋里走去。
屋门很厚，包着铁皮，推门时发出沉闷的声响。
门后是一条向下延伸的石阶。
石阶两侧的墙壁上每隔数步便嵌着一盏油灯，灯火摇曳，将几人的影子投在石壁上，忽长忽短。
越往下走，空气越热。
那是一种从地底深处涌上来的，带着硫磺气息的燥热。
老余头推开最底层的那扇石门，热气扑面而来。
这是一间方圆数丈的石室，正中是一个巨大的熔炉。
炉身以铜铁铸就，刻满了密密麻麻的符文。
那些符文在热气的熏蒸下微微发亮，像是在呼吸。
熔炉下方，地火涌动，赤红色的岩浆在地底深处缓缓流淌，将整间石室映得一片通红。
“这是地火。”
老余头走到熔炉前，伸手摸了摸炉身上滚烫的符文。
“从地底深处引上来，比炭火更烈，也更稳，千炼玄铁，只有地火才能熔。”
陆沉走到熔炉前，感受着那股从地底涌上来的热浪，心中微动。
这股地火中蕴含着浓郁的天地之力，乃是一种被大地孕育了千万年的，带着厚重与灼热的纯粹力量。
用来锻造千炼玄兵，确实比任何凡火都要合适。
他取出那些积攒了许久的材料，从玄戒中一件一件地取出，摆在熔炉前的石台上。
五十斤千炼玄铁，朝廷赐下的那一份，也是今日的主角。
百炼精钢，深海寒铁，玄英珠，从安立渊手中夺来的金钟碎片，还有之前缴获的诸多百炼玄兵……林林总总，摆满了石台。
老余头走过去，拿起那块千炼玄铁掂了掂，又拿起一块百炼精钢在手中端详，浑浊的老眼中闪过一丝亮光。
“东西不错。”他放下那块玄铁，看着陆沉，“你要打什么？”
content_en:
Early the next morning, King Mu personally took him out of the palace.
There were no carriages or horses, no entourage, only the small yellow gate following far behind, like an inconspicuous shadow.
They walked through the busiest long street in Fucheng and turned into an inconspicuous alley.
At the end of the alley is a mottled wooden door. There is no plaque or font size on the door. Only the word "craftsman" is engraved on the lintel, which has been eroded by wind and rain and is blurred.
Behind the wooden door is another world.
The courtyard is small, with blue bricks paving the floor, and several huge water tanks piled in the corners, with water lilies growing in the tanks.
Although it was early winter and the lotus leaves were withered, there were still a few koi swimming slowly under the remaining leaves.
An old man with white beard and hair was squatting in the corridor, holding a small hammer in his hand and hammering a piece of iron as big as a palm.
His movements were neither hasty nor hasty, each hammer landed on the same place, sparks flew everywhere, and the iron piece gradually became thinner and brighter in his hand, like a leaf that was stretching.
"Lao Yutou, stop knocking on your old piece of iron and come to work."
King Mu's tone was so casual that he didn't seem to be talking to a master-level craftsman.
Lao Yu raised his head, glanced at King Mu, and then at Lu Chen. His eyes stayed on him for a moment, then he put down the hammer and stood up.
He was short, slightly stooped, and wore a coarse cloth stained with rust and ashes.
If it weren't for King Mu's "Old Yutou" just now, Lu Chen would have thought he was just an ordinary blacksmith.
But his eyes were different.
There is a sharpness in the turbidity, as if you can see through the quality of a piece of iron in an instant, and you can also see through the depth of a person.
"My subordinate has met the prince, and the prince invites you."
Lao Yutou turned around and led the way towards the house.
The door was thick and covered with iron. It made a dull sound when the door was pushed open.
Behind the door is a stone staircase extending downward.
There is an oil lamp embedded in the walls on both sides of the stone steps every few steps. The light flickers, casting the shadows of several people on the stone wall, varying in length and length.
The further down you go, the hotter the air becomes.
It was a kind of heat that came up from the depths of the earth, with a sulfurous smell.
Lao Yu pushed open the stone door on the bottom floor, and the hot air hit his face.
This is a stone room several feet in diameter, with a huge furnace in the center.
The furnace body is made of copper and iron and is engraved with dense runes.
Those runes glowed slightly under the fumigation of the heat, as if they were breathing.
Under the furnace, the earth's fire surged, and red magma slowly flowed deep underground, making the entire stone chamber glow red.
"This is earth fire."
Lao Yu walked to the furnace and reached out to touch the hot runes on the furnace.
"It is brought up from the depths of the earth. It is stronger and more stable than charcoal fire. Thousands of refined black iron can only be melted by underground fire."
Lu Chen walked to the furnace, feeling the heat wave rising from the ground, and his heart moved slightly.
This earth fire contains the rich power of heaven and earth. It is a pure power that has been nurtured by the earth for thousands of years, with a heavy and scorching heat.
It is indeed more suitable than any ordinary fire for forging the Thousand Refining Mysterious Weapons.
He took out the materials that he had accumulated for a long time, took them out one by one from the mysterious ring, and placed them on the stone platform in front of the furnace.
The share of fifty kilograms of thousand-forged black iron given by the imperial court is also the protagonist of today.
Hundred-refined refined steel, deep-sea cold iron, Xuanying Pearl, the fragments of the golden bell taken from An Liyuan, and many previously captured Hundred-Refined Mysterious Weapons... all of them filled the stone platform.
Lao Yutou walked over, picked up the piece of thousand-refined black iron and weighed it, and then picked up a piece of hundred-refined steel and looked at it in his hand, a glimmer of light flashed in his muddy old eyes.
"It's not bad." He put down the piece of black iron and looked at Lu Chen, "What do you want to hit?"
